TA0063.title: APT / Nation-State Actor
TA0063.description: State-sponsored advanced persistent threat organizations with substantial resources, time, and expertise. Their typical targets include critical infrastructure, government agencies, defense contractors, high-tech enterprises, and research institutions. Attack methods include zero-day exploitation, custom malware, supply chain compromise, long-term persistence, and lateral movement. Unlike common cybercrime, APT objectives focus on intelligence collection, intellectual property theft, or destructive operations rather than direct financial gain.
